[page[title]]

An OData CRUD Put or Patch action that returns the updated representation must return 200 OK.

What the Standard says

RFC 9110 permits 200 when an update returns content and 204 when it intentionally returns no content; cCoder adopts 200 for its representation-returning update profile. read it here.

Why it matters

Enforcing this rule gives callers and maintainers one predictable contract and makes drift visible during the build. The analyser proves this specific source-level condition; it does not replace runtime acceptance or security testing.

Bad code example

// Violates RFC0004
return NoContent();

Good code example

// Follows RFC0004
return Updated(updatedStudent);
